subject: [VolPred Alert][INFO] P6 PRG 升 ready_for_submission（9 paper 首篇）
body:
Alert level: info
Title: P6 PRG 升 ready_for_submission（9 paper 首篇）

P6 PRG (Periodic Realized GARCH) 經 4 輪 paper-review-cycle (v1-v4) + v4.1 batch fix 收斂後升 ready_for_submission stage（9 paper portfolio 首篇達此 stage）。

6-criteria gate: 6/6 PASS
- latex 4.2★ verified（v4），4.4-4.6 predicted post-v4.1
- citation GREEN PASS（0 MAJOR / ≤2 MED）
- cross-paper meta no fundamental issue（NotebookLM 2 critical issues CLOSED+STRENGTHENED）
- 真實接受率 35-45% desk-accept + 50% R&R = 85-95% positive predicted
- K1260 fair-info GJR-X benchmark close fairness issue
- 無方法論套套邏輯

Target journal: Finance Research Letters (FRL)
PDF: 15 pages, 22 bibitems, 184-word abstract
Highlight: §4.5 K1260 PRG vs GJR-X DM=7.72 是 paper 最強 single statistic, confirms session-bridge structural mechanism

決策待您 confirm:
1. 是否投稿 FRL? (status 將從 ready_for_submission → submitted)
2. 或延遲投稿維持 ready stage + 每月 1 輪 continuous review loop?

Pre-submission 主線程仍需驗證:
- paper/prg-periodic-garch/reproduce.py 存在 + exit 0
- reproduce_report.json match_rate ≥ 95% + alert_level=green

詳: paper/prg-periodic-garch/SUBMISSION_READY.md
Audit: paper/prg-periodic-garch/review_history/v1-v4/
